verdict.rationale: jo documents an official native macOS app that runs on your Mac and shares memory with its other surfaces, so the desktop-app part of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence mentions global keyboard shortcuts or reading what is on the user's screen, which are the power-user parts of the story. missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, screen-content access or screen awareness, any in-depth desktop app docs or hands-on corroboration.
